title: From anti-solvent synthesis to polaron-driven transport: exploring the promise of lead-free Rb2SnCl6 nanocrystals
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,24675-24688
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA01082B, Paper

Abderraouf Jraba, Saber Nasri, Iheb Garoui, Abderrazek Oueslati, Elimame Elaloui
Rb2SnCl6 nanocrystals exhibiting a stable cubic vacancy-ordered perovskite structure. The material demonstrates promising potential for optoelectronic applications due to its strong UV absorption and thermally activated charge transport behaviour.
